name: SpaceX Starlink factory
blurb: Beside the suburban streets of Redmond Ridge, a cluster of plain business-park buildings turns out SpaceX's Starlink satellites, about 70 a week.

name: Amazon Spheres
blurb: Some 40,000 cloud-forest plants fill Amazon's three glass domes, a jungle workspace for employees tucked beneath the company's downtown towers.

name: Dempster Highway
blurb: Gravel road to the Arctic: it crests North Fork Pass in Tombstone Park, crosses the Arctic Circle and leaves the Yukon at Wright Pass, bound for Inuvik.
facts: type: gravel highway | length_km: 736 | high_point_m: 1328 | road: Yukon Hwy 5 / NWT Hwy 8 | built: begun 1959; opened 1979
